harnessChange: Adds mandatory successful retry after pinned outputs are released, preserving the same lake, pool and cache.
limitations: No cancellation or fairness proof; jobs launch in a fixed order.
Observed recovery is for owned collection of the stated Parquet fixture, not every operator.
R2 is the local workerd binding; HTTP is localhost with a verified 64 MiB managed-heap flag.
Managed heap excludes external/native backing; sparse samples are not whole-runtime peak bounds.
Additional recovery operations affect later cache state and round elapsed time; not comparable to the baseline latency benchmark.
